subject: Mutual action plan: Acme Robotics evaluation — environment onboarding & gating
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: J. Patel <j.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan (draft) + first steps for eval environment onboarding

J — pleasure connecting last week. Attaching a working draft of the MAP (redwood_acme_map_v1.pdf) and a small CSV template for the IP allowlist we typically use. This thread to capture owners and dates so we can close the trial environment and proceed to the demo run.

Key technical gating items we need to complete on our side / yours:
1) Org & tenant creation: we need the name/email for the service account admin so we can seed the tenant and send an invite (owner: Naomi).
2) API keys: we'll issue a scoped API key for the eval org once step #1 is complete (owner: Ben).
3) IP allowlist: please populate the attached CSV with the firewall ranges you'll open to our endpoints; we will provide the public endpoints in parallel (owner: Acme / contact: J. Patel).
4) VPC peering (optional for this trial): if you want private connectivity we can coordinate peering; initial verification requires an STS handshake and a CIDR plan (owner: Grace).

Proposed milestone dates (please flag conflicts):
- 2026-05-05 : org invite completed + API key issuance
- 2026-05-07 : IP allowlist entries validated and tested
- 2026-05-10 : sanbox smoke test (end-to-end generation, latency check)
- 2026-05-14 : optional VPC peering window (if requested)
- 2026-05-21 : target evaluation close / exec demo

Please reply with owners for the org admin & procurement contact, and confirm whether you want VPC peering during this eval. I also copied Ben and Grace from our infra team — they will lead keys and networking.

Attachments: redwood_acme_map_v1.pdf (MAP draft), allowlist-template.csv (IP ranges template)

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: J. Patel <j.patel@acmecorp.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan (draft) + first steps for eval environment onboarding

Thanks Naomi — quick network note from my side. When you populate the allowlist-template.csv please include both the public NAT range and any load-balancer egress addresses; we need explicit /28 or /24 CIDR blocks so our infra can open the right ACLs. If Acme prefers we can also provide a transient test endpoint for an MRT to validate traffic before you update production firewall rules.

Can J share the primary management contact and the internal ticketing reference (if you have one) so we can coordinate maintenance windows? Also, which AWS region are you planning to run the evaluation in? We'll seed the org in us-west-2 unless you ask otherwise.

cc: Dylan Brooks — tagging you for telemetry & tracing config during the smoke test.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: J. Patel <j.patel@acmecorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com, platform@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan (draft) + first steps for eval environment onboarding

Hi Naomi / team — thanks, this looks good. A few notes from Acme's side: 
- We will provide the org admin (sanjay.patel@acmecorp.com) and procurement contact (procurement@acmecorp.com) by EOD Wednesday.
- For the allowlist, we can open the ranges the week of 5/10; right now our change window is Tues/Thurs 02:00-05:00 UTC for production firewalls. If possible, please give the exact endpoint IPs this week so we can schedule.
- We need a short security questionnaire and SOC2 attestation before procurement will move a PO. Can you share a SOC2 summary and a contact for security?

Regarding VPC peering: we are open to it but it will likely require a separate security review and an internal network ticket. For the trial I'd prefer starting with public allowlist + scoped API key unless you recommend otherwise for performance reasons.

J. Patel
Head of Platform Engineering — Acme Robotics
j.patel@acmecorp.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: J. Patel <j.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan (draft) + first steps for eval environment onboarding

Thanks J — noted on change windows and procurement ask. Per your request I attached a short SOC2 one-pager and a draft SLA (draft-sla.docx). Below is an edited MAP with explicit owners and the airtight gating steps so we can avoid back-and-forth the week before the demo. Please review and confirm owners + dates.

Mutual Action Plan (concise) — Redwood / Acme owners & dates
1) Org invite & admin confirmation
   - Owner: Acme (S. Patel) / Naomi to seed invite
   - Target: 2026-05-05 EOD
2) Scoped API key issuance
   - Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood)
   - Target: 2026-05-06 morning (key limited to eval org)
3) IP allowlist & firewall window
   - Owner: Acme network team (procurement & platform)
   - Action: Populate allowlist-template.csv and schedule change for week of 2026-05-10 (Target validation: 2026-05-07)
4) Smoke test & telemetry validation (end-to-end)
   - Owner: Dylan Brooks (Redwood) / Acme platform engineer
   - Target: 2026-05-10 09:00-11:00 PT
5) Optional VPC peering kickoff (if Acme requests)
   - Owner: Grace O'Connor (Redwood) / Acme network
   - Target kickoff: 2026-05-11 (security review to follow)
6) Exec demo & evaluation close
   - Owner: Naomi Feldman / Acme product lead
   - Target: 2026-05-21

Open items for Acme to confirm: org admin email, procurement contact, and whether you want peering during this trial. Once we have those I will: 1) issue the scoped API key, 2) send endpoint IPs for allowlisting, and 3) schedule the smoke test with Dylan.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, draft-sla.docx (redacted)

Best,
Naomi

From: J. Patel <j.patel@acmecorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan (draft) + first steps for eval environment onboarding

Naomi — we confirm the org admin is sanjay.patel@acmecorp.com and procurement will be in touch (procurement@acmecorp.com). Acme agrees to the timeline; we'll schedule the firewall change for Tue 2026-05-11 02:00 UTC and validate on 05/12. Procurement expects to review the SOC2 summary and will return a PO approval by the week of 05/17.

For now, we will proceed with public allowlist + scoped API key (no peering for the initial run). Please send endpoints and the key when ready.

Thanks — J.
